It also uses **Lead** _Mobile No_ values and correctly extracts phone numbers from recipient entries. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/61683) * Fixes stock and order handling, including item-price selection, warehouse and weight updates, links between **Sales Orders** and **Purchase Orders**, and customer shipping addresses on drop-ship **Purchase Orders**. Also fixes an accounting default issue and removes comments, versions, and attachments when old logs are deleted. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/60744) * The item barcode scanning dialog now shows an error and plays the configured failure sound when a scanned barcode, batch, or serial number does not match the selected item. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/61804) * When you disassemble a manufactured **Stock Entry** in multiple partial entries, each later entry skips serial numbers used by earlier disassemblies of the same source. (https://github.com/frappe/erpnext/pull/61821) * Adjusts the _Must Be Whole Number_ check to account for small rounding differences in unit conversions, so quantities that round to a whole number aren’t rejected as fractional.
